description:
In the wake of the explosive and devastating Oklahoma City Bombing on April 19, 1995, it’s a race against time to find survivors. Speculation over who is responsible spreads as investigators launch a nationwide search to find the attacker. Questions of motivation also start to fall into place as the FBI makes connections between the date of the bombing and the anniversary of the Waco Siege. Their search leads them to Timothy McVeigh.
